subject: Population strategy + vectorstore reconciliation & rerank QA plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rivers <emma@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Population strategy + vectorstore reconciliation & rerank QA plan

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our trial goals, the two things we want to align on this week are: (1) a safe, low-latency population approach for your product catalog (initial ~2M vectors) and (2) a pragmatic rerank QA workflow so we can measure precision gains before any traffic cutover.

Quick ask: can you send the current export of item metadata (CSV or parquet) and confirm which vectorstore you plan to use in production (your notes mentioned Atlas Search but I want the exact cluster name and whether you have snapshot exports enabled). I attached a lightweight population matrix you can fill in — it lists fields we need and a recommended batching cadence.

High-level proposal (short):
- Population: incremental prefix/backfill approach — seed the 200k high-priority items first for quick smoke tests, then continuous backfill in 500k batches overnight.
- Vectorstore reconciliation: take a snapshot, verify counts + checksums, then run a small sample query set (we provide) to compare similarity scores.
- Rerank QA: 3-stage eval — seed human-labeled set (100 queries), model-in-the-loop A/B (holdout), and post-backfill behavioral checks (CTR/Precision proxies).

I've attached the population matrix and a rerank eval template to get us started. Monica — can you pick up the evaluation templates and turn them into a shared checklist? Karthik — we'll need your help designing the smoke test prompts.

Proposed timeline: initial seed and smoke tests by Thu 3/11, first 500k backfill Wed 3/17, full 2M complete by Fri 3/26 (can be tightened pending export performance).

No production changes required for the first seed; we'll do all runs against a staging index and point a small canary to staging via a routing rule.

Attachments: acme_population_matrix.csv, rerank_eval_templates.md

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Thanks — attached the export (summary inlined here):

- We currently run on an Atlas Search managed cluster: cluster-id: atlas-prod-7, snapshots enabled weekly (last snapshot: 2027-03-06).

A couple constraints to flag:

- Peak ingest window is Tue/Thu 01:00–04:00 UTC; we'd prefer heavy backfills outside that window.

On rerank: we can allocate product folks to label ~150 queries if that helps.

I've also looped in Atlas Search Support to confirm snapshot export format and to ask about a fast-export option.

Heads-up — I've taken the rerank template and sketched a concrete checklist. Key items for our side:

1) Seed selection (owner: Karthik):
   - Produce 100 human-labeled queries with positive/negative judgments (format: qid, query_text, gold_doc_ids).
   - Deliver by Thu 3/11 EOD.

2) Staging population (owner: Soojin):
   - Validate export schema against population_matrix. Fill missing fields or map columns.
   - Run initial 200k seed (high-priority SKUs) on staging cluster. Notify Emma when ready.

3) Smoke tests & metrics (owner: Monica):
   - Run sample queries (we'll use the 100 q set) and record recall@10, mean reciprocal rank, and rerank precision.
   - Provide a one-pager with results and suggested thresholds.

4) Backfill cadence & rollback (owner: Laura):
   - Coordinate timed backfills (500k/night) and prepare a rollback plan (index snapshot restore + routing fallback).

I've added the checklist to the Drive link Soojin created and attached a short vstore-migration-checklist.xlsx for Laura's operational steps.

I'll own the smoke-test artifact and the final QA one-pager.

Monica

monica.patel@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Population strategy + vectorstore reconciliation & rerank QA plan

Thanks all — quick confirmations and some operational notes.

Emma: if Atlas can provide a snapshot export in .tar.gz with a simple JSONL per-shard format, that will speed ingestion. Support — if you can confirm exported file layout and a recommended chunk size for our ingestion tooling (we prefer ~100k file chunks), we can do an expedited backfill.

Karthik: please prioritize the 100 labeled queries. If product can spare 150, we can split 100/50 (100 baseline for rerank evals, 50 for edge-case checks). Monica and I will pair on the MRR/precision thresholds.

Laura: can you draft the rollback steps using the attached vstore-migration-checklist? Include steps for snapshot restore, DNS/routing rollback, and rate-limiting to protect the cluster during restore. Suggested rollback window: 30–60 minutes to roll back a single 500k batch.

Operational plan (concise):
- Thu 3/11 AM: seed 200k on staging and run smoke tests (no traffic).
- Wed 3/17 02:00 UTC: start first 500k backfill (out of peak). Monitor ingest TPS and rerank score deltas; abort if errors >0.5% or if cluster CPU > 70%.
- Weekly checkpoints + final sign-off by Acme on 3/26.

Next steps: Emma to confirm Atlas snapshot format and allowed windows; Karthik to share labeled queries; Monica will publish smoke-test one-pager; Laura to prepare rollback doc.

Onwards —
Soojin
